candidate_contract.signature: void matmul_16x16_llm(data_t lhs[16][16], data_t rhs[16][16], data_t output[16][16])
candidate_contract.operation: For each row r and column c, compute output[r][c] = sum_k lhs[r][k] * rhs[k][c].

testbench.input_rule: Use deterministic small fixed-point values for lhs and rhs.
testbench.golden_rule: Compute the golden result with the same data_t fixed-point accumulation order as the design, or use a tolerance of 0.05 to account for ap_fixed<12,4> quantization.

demo.description: LLM candidate version of the MatMul resource demo; used to compare generated HLS against the deterministic fallback path.
